wolfs-gravestone.name: Wolf's Gravestone
wolfs-gravestone.description: A longsword used by the Wolf Knight. Originally just a heavy sheet of iron given to the knight by a blacksmith from the city, it became endowed with legendary power owing to his friendship with the wolves.
wolfs-gravestone.passiveDescription: Increases ATK by {0}%. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by {1}% for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.
